sentence: Tracks a group gift fund toward a goal, where members pledge an amount, record what they sent to a chosen money holder, and the holder confirms receipt.
use_when: A group is chipping in for a shared gift and wants to see progress toward the total
Someone needs to track who pledged and who has actually paid
Money is sent to one or two people who collect it and confirm it
A group wants a simple view of how much is left to raise before a deadline
dont_use_when: Splitting a bill or dining costs between people after the fact
Voting on what gift or option to pick
Moving real money or taking payments inside the chat
Tracking ongoing shared expenses or debts over time
